entries.zh: 相对；迎面正对着（当头）；另读指抵押品（当头）
entries.en: opposites; things facing each other head-on; (another reading) pawned collateral
entries.notes: M/R 两栏均有[疑]注记，'當頭'兼'迎面相对'与'抵押品'两读，按本页 contrario 词族取'相对'义。

entries.zh: 违逆于人、与之作对；轻慢触犯、轻蔑
entries.en: to be contrary to someone; to slight, despise (menospreciar)
entries.notes: 西语尾文疑为 menospreciar（轻蔑）之拼写残误；M 栏 tàp/fàp 存疑，取'轻慢触犯'义。

entries.zh: 对头；对家、仇家、敌对之人
entries.en: adversary; opponent, enemy

entries.zh: 对手；相匹敌之人；亦指搭挡、帮手
entries.en: opponent, rival; (in Min usage) partner, helper

entries.zh: 犯讳；触犯名讳忌讳、冒犯尊长名讳
entries.en: to violate a taboo; to offend by uttering a forbidden (honorific) name

entries.zh: 驳运；雇船转载货物；亦指反驳、驳价
entries.en: to transship cargo by lighter; to hire craft; also to refute, to contest a price
entries.notes: 汉字'駁'与两栏对音 huàn 不合（对音近'贩'），按本页贸易语境取'驳运'义，兼存'反驳'义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏与双语对音栏全空（大面积缺损），西语残句难解。

entries.zh: 生理；生意、买卖、营生（做生理）
entries.en: business, commerce; trade, dealing

entries.zh: 生涯；生计、赖以为生的营生之道
entries.en: livelihood; one's trade or means of living

entries.zh: 交加；与人交往、相交做买卖；（本义）交错夹杂
entries.en: to associate and deal with; (lit.) intermingled, occurring together

entries.zh: 交通；往来交接、结交勾通
entries.en: to have dealings with; to communicate, be connected

entries.zh: 对货；以货对货、配货交易
entries.en: to deal in merchandise; to match or barter goods

entries.zh: 对店货；就店铺货物订约交易、备店货买卖
entries.en: to trade in store goods; to stock and deal goods at a shop

entries.zh: 买卖；买进卖出、做买卖
entries.en: buying and selling; trade

entries.zh: 取裁；裁决、定夺、取决
entries.en: to decide, determine; to take as one's criterion

entries.zh: 痊安；病愈康复、康复而安
entries.en: to convalesce, recover strength; to be healed and well
entries.notes: 汉字'瘥/産'存疑，据西语 Conualecere（=convalescere，病愈强壮）取'痊安'义。

entries.zh: 痊；痊愈、病愈
entries.en: to recover from illness; to be cured

entries.zh: 止口；封堵其口、使人哑口无言（辩而服之）
entries.en: to stop someone's mouth; to silence, refute in argument

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏残损且第二音节 T99 污损，H'神速'与西语'以理说服（convencer con la razón）'难以互证。

entries.zh: 考倒人；考试或盘问中把人难倒、问倒众人
entries.en: to stump people with hard questions in an examination

entries.zh: 雍；和合相调、协调一致（取'雍，和也'之义）
entries.en: to agree, be fitting; to conform, be in accord
entries.notes: 汉字雍/庸两读存疑，取与 Conuenir. g. conformar（相合）相应之'雍（和也）'义。
